description: This file contains unit tests for the BookRepository component of a Java Spring project, utilizing JUnit 5 and assertions to verify repository behaviors related to Book entity operations.

classes.name: BookRepositoryTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing BookRepository database operations including delete, find, and retrieve for books associated with users, authors, and shelves.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Setup method annotated with @BeforeEach to initialize test environment by clearing the database and inserting required test data.

methods.name: successfullyDeleteABook_whenAuthorHasOtherBooks
methods.description: Test that deleting a specific book does not delete other books by the same author.

methods.name: successfullyDeleteSingleAuthoredBook
methods.description: Test that deleting a book with a unique author removes it from repository.

methods.name: canFindBookByTitle
methods.description: Test that books can be found by partial title search, verifying different search terms.

methods.name: allBooksFoundWhenNoFilterPassed
methods.description: Disabled test to verify if all books are retrieved when no search filter is provided.

methods.name: canFindBookByTitleOrAuthor
methods.description: Disabled test to verify search by either title or author.

methods.name: canFindBookByAuthor
methods.description: Disabled test to verify search functionality by author's first or last name.

methods.name: canGetAllBooksForUser
methods.description: Test verifying retrieval of all books associated with a specific user.
